text:
maya: Heads up — post-summit group grab? I'm craving banh mi or khao soup. Anyone around Market/Nob Hill with late-night recs? Guest in town.

aj: Banh mi is the move. Bánh Mì Boys on 3rd has great pate + jalapeño, open til ~1am.

sam: +1 for Bánh Mì Boys, also PhoCircus on Kearny has a late pho menu, but it's more soup than khao.

rolf: Khao Ga (Polk) does a late chicken-rice/khao soi-ish bowl that hits after a long day. Open 24h on weekends last I checked.

maya: @amy-guest — what are you in the mood for? spicy, crunchy, or soup?

amy-guest: Crunchy and portable please. Also celiac-friendly options would be awesome.

aj: For GF, try Little Saigon on Ellis — they do rice-banh-mi (wraps) and smaller portions. Not super late tho (til 10:30).

sam: Quick poll? What do people prefer tonight: 1) Banh mi (sandwich) 2) Khao soup/bowl 3) Tacos/late taqueria

lunchbot: Poll created — vote with the number emoji.

maya: 1️⃣
aj: 1️⃣

rolf: 2️⃣ (leaning soup if it's cold)

amy-guest: 1️⃣ (gluten-free rice wrap if possible)

sam: 1️⃣

lunchbot: Poll results: 1) Banh mi — 4 votes, 2) Khao soup — 1 vote, 3) Tacos — 0 votes.

maya: OK banh mi it is. Who wants pickup vs meet there? I'm happy to pick up if folks chip in.

aj: I'll Venmo $12 for mine. Tag me.

rolf: Meet there for me — I want to stretch legs after the summit. ETA 10:10pm?

maya: Ordering plan: Bánh Mì Boys (3rd St) — menu quick links: https://example.com/banhmiboys-menu. If anyone needs GF rice-wrap, say so now.

sam: Can you add 2x extra jalapeños on mine? 

amy-guest: GF rice-wrap for me pls, no soy sauce. Thanks!

aj: If pickup, can you hold 2 sandwiches while I run from the afterparty? arriving ~10:20.

maya: Yep — I’ll place the order for 6 and hold 2. Plan: meet at the Market St entrance of the conference at 10:05 or pick up at 10:25.

rolf: Perfect. Also FYI for future travelers — Khao Soup House (Polk) has a tiny dining room and great late pho, good when the city is cold.

maya: Quick address block:
```
Bánh Mì Boys — 301 3rd St (near Market)
Khao Soup House — 112 Polk St
Little Saigon — 450 Ellis St
```

sam: Linking Yelp for photos: https://yelp.com/banhmiboys (pics look fire)

lunchbot: Reminder scheduled — "Pickup reminder for Bánh Mì Boys" at 10:15 PM.

aj: Thanks maya! Appreciate the rescue. :hero-sandwich: :thumbsup:

amy-guest: Yay, excited. See you all there. :)

maya: See you — I'll post when I'm leaving to pick up.

(last message) maya: heading out to pickup now, will DM for payment details.
